name: gauntlet
description: Build a production-grade app with an AI agent, review each change, then harden it before launch. Three independent commands: /gauntlet:build turns a plain-English idea into ~16 numbered build prompts with verifiable checkpoints. /gauntlet:review runs a diff-scoped multi-agent code review with adversarial verification (expensive - spawns many subagents). /gauntlet:harden runs the A-G pre-launch audit cascade. Run any one on its own. Includes the 144-item web rubric, 162-item mobile rubric, a CLI primer for non-developers, and a worked example. Every gate is proven able to fail before it is trusted.
